title: CertiSafe – Certificate Management System
summary: A deployed certificate-management platform for an institute, designed to organize certificate records and securely manage associated media.

highlights: Led a 4-member team to build and deploy a certificate management platform for my institute.
Integrated AWS DynamoDB and Cloudinary for secure data and media handling; onboarded 95+ users.

overview: CertiSafe is an institutional certificate-management platform built to organize certificate records and their associated media.
I led a four-member team through implementation and deployment of the working application.
problem: Certificate information and media need a consistent, accessible system instead of fragmented manual records.
solution: A React and Node.js application stores structured certificate data in DynamoDB and manages certificate media through Cloudinary.

howItWorks.title: Record management
howItWorks.description: Users create and manage structured certificate records through the web interface.

howItWorks.title: Data storage
howItWorks.description: The backend persists application data in DynamoDB.

howItWorks.title: Media handling
howItWorks.description: Certificate images are uploaded and delivered through Cloudinary.

buildingProcess.title: Team planning
buildingProcess.description: Split the platform into clear implementation areas and coordinated work across a four-member team.

buildingProcess.title: Full-stack implementation
buildingProcess.description: Connected the React interface to Node.js and Express services backed by DynamoDB and Cloudinary.

buildingProcess.title: Deployment
buildingProcess.description: Prepared and deployed the application for institutional use.

challenges.challenge: Coordinating application data with separately hosted certificate media.
challenges.solution: Stored structured records in DynamoDB while using Cloudinary for media-specific storage and delivery.
challenges.lesson: Different data types benefit from services designed for their access and delivery patterns.

highlights: Led a four-member team through implementation and deployment.
Used DynamoDB for application data and Cloudinary for certificate media handling.
Delivered a working institutional platform rather than a standalone prototype.
lessonsLearned: How to coordinate a small development team.
How to separate structured data storage from media delivery.
How deployment requirements shape full-stack implementation decisions.
